thread:
tanya_w: hey all, happy to be here! trying to enroll my company Mac (macOS 13.5) and enrollment errors out with 'Profile approval required' and then asks for a consent code i never received. any pointers? :wave:
it_helpdesk: welcome @tanya_w :tada: consent codes are usually emailed during provisioning but sometimes the new-hire batch missed them. can you share the serial and sw_vers?
tanya_w: serial C02Y7B2KGH9R, sw_vers 13.5
ops_bot: checklist: 1) Ensure root cert installed 2) Install wifi profile from onboarding email 3) Try manual mobileconfig enrollment if the web flow fails
it_helpdesk: looks like your device is in 'Awaiting Consent' state in Jamf. @sam_ops can you generate a one-time consent code for that serial?
sam_ops: generated OOB consent: 5XQ-2LM-8TQ (DM sent). note: if cert chain issues appear, ask new-hires to install the 'Redwood Root CA' to System keychain first.
tanya_w: entered the code and approved the profile. enrollment shows successful now, thanks. FileVault shows 'Pending' though. will it enable automatically? :lock:
it_helpdesk: our policy enforces FileVault but macOS sometimes defers enable until first unlock. i'm queuing the MDM task to trigger enable+escrow now. ops_bot: Deploy job 7321 started: push/filevault-enable -> target: C02Y7B2KGH9R

it_helpdesk: also, do you need local admin for Homebrew/Docker? default is non-admin. for onboarding we do a temporary 7-day sudo. request if needed and we'll grant it.
tanya_w: yes please, need to install brew and Docker. request submitted.
dev_env_bot: note: if you install Docker Desktop during the admin window, follow the bootstrap script in the onboarding DM to configure group permissions so the app works after sudo is revoked.
it_helpdesk: 7-day admin granted. once you finish, reply here and we'll schedule auto-removal.
tanya_w: ran the bootstrap, brew and Docker installed, fdesetup status shows 'FileVault On.' thanks everyone! small Q: where to ask for screen recording permission for Zoom?
it_helpdesk: request entitlements in #it-help with the app name and reason. for Zoom we usually require minimal entitlements and a short justification.
tanya_w: got it. thanks again, super smooth. marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
